capabilities: Import selected books from a Calibre Content Server as one note per book with frontmatter metadata and cover image
Fetch Kobo highlights grouped by chapter into the book notes
Re-import or sync books while preserving user-written content and fields like status and reading dates
Generate a Bases library overview with Reading, Unread, Read, and Did Not Finish views
extras: Warns that a Calibre password is stored in plaintext in the plugin's data file, and that Calibre-sourced tags are overwritten on re-import (use a separate field for your own tags). Pre-release versions installable via BRAT (P24L/calibre-bridge).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a Calibre library's book metadata, covers, and Kobo highlights into vault notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin connects only to the Calibre Content Server you configure
Kobo highlights, if you've fetched them into Calibre — quoted passages grouped by chapter

summary: Imports books from a Calibre Content Server as Markdown notes with metadata, covers, and Kobo highlights, and re-syncs them on demand.
